cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis. Defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine @5; no reinforcing strong anionic. Laureth-9 @3 (Polidocanol) is a fatty-alcohol ethoxylate in no C3 cleansing class (not a glucoside/betaine/acylate): recorded, not a buffer.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful conditioning system, the prominent cationic Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @7, plus humectants Urea @6, Glycerin @9, Panthenol @14. No silicone, no payload lipid, no pearlizer, so C2 not met and high not reachable. Counter-signal: a single guar with humectants could read as low (light care).

Menthol @12, Mentha Arvensis Leaf Oil @16 (cooling/essential oil, 6.4)
